title: CLI Modes & Navigation
description: Move between User EXEC, Privileged EXEC, and Global Config modes confidently.
scenario: Move between User EXEC, Privileged EXEC, and Global Config modes confidently.

concepts.title: User EXEC Mode (>)
concepts.body: The default mode when you connect. Read-only commands only. The prompt ends with ">".

concepts.title: Privileged EXEC Mode (#)
concepts.body: Type "enable" to enter. The prompt ends with "#". Unlocks show, write, copy, and configure commands.

concepts.title: Global Config Mode (config)#
concepts.body: Type "configure terminal" from privileged mode. The prompt shows "(config)#". Use "exit" to go back one level, "end" to jump to privileged.
concepts.code:
Switch# configure terminal
Switch(config)# exit
Switch#
